# Release Semaphore Reference

![Release Semaphore Reference function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/semaphore/release_reference.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Closes this handle and its aliases, interrupts only its pending acquisitions, and returns the semaphore name. Other handles survive normal close; force destroy invalidates all handles and waits. Executes despite upstream error. FROG v1 does not implicitly return already acquired accesses when another handle keeps the resource alive.

Ferme ce handle et ses alias, interrompt ses acquisitions en attente et retourne le nom. Les autres handles survivent à une fermeture ordinaire ; force destroy invalide tous les handles et attentes. Agit malgré l’erreur amont. FROG v1 ne rend pas automatiquement les accès déjà acquis si un autre handle maintient la ressource.

## Types and connection rules

Fixed nominal SemaphoreRef without a message type parameter. Preserve the exact handle class across aggregates and boundaries; reject Queue, Notifier, control and file references.

- Type resolution: `fixed`; result expression: `declared_output_type`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: not accepted; lifting policy: `none`.

A semaphore handle carries no user-message T. No implicit array lifting or conversion from another reference class.

**Input count:** 3; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

Port order: `semaphore` → `force_destroy` → `error_in`.
